description: This file defines the AndroidGotoRelatedProvider class, which extends GotoRelatedProvider to provide navigation features related to Android components within an IDE. It includes methods for retrieving related items such as layout files, manifest declarations, and Java classes based on the context element, primarily for Android development support in IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio.

classes.name: AndroidGotoRelatedProvider
classes.description: Provides related navigation items for Android components, such as layouts and manifest entries, within the IDE.

classes.name: MyGotoRelatedLayoutItem
classes.description: Represents a layout file in the related navigation items.

classes.name: MyGotoManifestItem
classes.description: Represents the AndroidManifest.xml in the related navigation items.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns a list of related navigation items for a given PSI element.

methods.name: getLazyItemsComputable
methods.description: Lazily computes related items based on the PSI element's context.

methods.name: getLazyItemsForXmlFile
methods.description: Retrieves related Java files for a layout XML file.

methods.name: getLazyItemsForClass
methods.description: Retrieves related layout files and manifest declarations for a Java class.

methods.name: findDeclarationInManifest
methods.description: Finds the manifest declaration corresponding to a given class.

methods.name: isInheritorOfContextClass
methods.description: Checks if a class inherits from known Android context classes.

methods.name: collectRelatedJavaFiles
methods.description: Collects Java classes related to a layout resource.

methods.name: isInheritorOfOne
methods.description: Checks if a class inherits from any class in a collection.

methods.name: collectRelatedLayoutFiles
methods.description: Collects layout files related to a given class.
